company.shortDescription: TigerEye provides AI tools for construction professionals to manage information and documents.
company.description: TigerEye provides AI tools for construction professionals to manage information and documents. The platform organizes and links sources, summaries, and submittals to save time on searches and approvals. Data is stored securely and privacy is maintained, following standards such as SOC2, CCPA, GDPR, and ISO certifications. The platform includes knowledge and practices from experienced construction superintendents. It supports construction teams by making information easier to access and manage on-site. The system integrates modern AI technology to assist with daily field operations and project management.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $30,000,000, or 85.71% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $34,482,300 to $137,728,890, a 3.99x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
